cta_caption: Comment EMAILS aur main full guide DM kar dunga 📩

slides.headline: DM MEIN [EMAIL] MAANGO
slides.label: SHORT ANSWER
lines: Comment → DM **email maangta** hai → reply → **link** milta hai.

slides.headline: [FREEBIE] BANAO
slides.label: STEP 1
lines: Email ke layak **freebie**: checklist, template, mini-course.

slides.headline: REEL [POST] KARO
slides.label: STEP 2
lines: "Comment **GUIDE** and I'll send it" wali reel daalo.

slides.headline: [ASK FOR EMAIL] ON
slides.label: STEP 3
lines: ReplyInbox mein comment automation banao, **Ask for email** on karo, link add karo.

slides.headline: [SHEETS] MEIN SAVE
slides.label: AUTO SAVE
lines: Emails **auto save**, Google Sheets ya email tool mein. **WhatsApp** number bhi le sakte ho.
